title: VoiceFeatureRecord
description: Engineering record of acoustic and prosodic features extracted from one consented voice recording by the audio-processing worker. It is a measurement record, not a clinical prediction, screening result or diagnosis. It contains no direct identifiers, no raw audio and no transcript content. Supersedes contracts/voice-feature-schema.json v1.0.0.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Must match the version in $id.

record_type.description: Fixed marker distinguishing this record from any model output. A feature record never carries a prediction, score, label or diagnosis.

record_id.description: Unique identifier of this feature record.

session_id.description: Pseudonymous voice session identifier. Randomly generated; never derived from or reversible to a direct identifier without the separately held identity mapping.

recording_id.description: Pseudonymous identifier of the recording within the session.

processing_job_id.description: Identifier of the audio-processing job that produced this record.

consent_reference.description: Reference to the consent event that authorised processing. Holds IDs and scopes only, never consent form content. Consumers must re-check current consent status with the consent service (or the consent-filtered export) before use; this snapshot does not authorise future use on its own.

consent_event_id.description: Immutable consent event identifier. Must resolve in the consent service; never a placeholder.

scopes_verified.description: Consent scopes that were active and checked when extraction ran. AUDIO_RECORDING must be present for a record to exist.

verified_at_utc.description: When the consent check was performed (UTC).

language_tag.description: BCP-47 tag of the spoken language, as declared at capture. Initial supported values: en-IN, kn-IN.

extraction.description: Tool and configuration used, with enough detail to reproduce the extraction.

config_id.description: Identifier of the versioned openSMILE configuration file in the processing worker repository. Configs are immutable once used.

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact configuration file used.

feature_set.description: Named openSMILE feature set. CUSTOM requires documentation of the config in the processing worker repository.

feature_level.description: Whether features are per-recording functionals or frame-level descriptors. v2.0.0 records carry FUNCTIONALS only in practice; frame-level output belongs in a separate artefact.

pipeline_commit.description: Source commit of the worker build, if known.

container_image_digest.description: Digest of the worker container image, if run in a container.

audio.description: Technical properties of the processed audio. Never contains the audio itself.

resampled_to_hz.description: Sampling rate after any resampling before extraction; null if none.

status.description: Records are only written for completed extractions. Failed jobs are reported through the processing job status, not as feature records.

warnings.description: Technical warning codes, e.g. NO_VOICED_FRAMES_IN_SEGMENTS, RESAMPLED_INPUT. Codes only, so no participant data can leak through free text.

quality.description: Server-side quality-control result. FAIL-quality audio produces no feature record.

degraded_reason.description: Required when status is DEGRADED. Short technical justification written by the processing team's rules, never participant information. It is dropped from research exports.

features.description: Extracted features. Names are the native openSMILE names and must not be renamed to clinical terms.

data_origin.description: Origin of the audio. SYNTHETIC and AUTHORIZED_TEST_AUDIO records may validate software only and must never be used as evidence of clinical performance.

capture_device_class.description: Device class only. Never a device identifier.

recorded_at_utc.description: Capture time, recorded by the device. Consumers needing less precision should truncate.

consentScope.description: Consent scopes approved for implementation with synthetic data on 2026-10-18 (privacy/legal review pending). Definitions: docs/privacy/consent-and-data-lifecycle.md.

name.description: Native openSMILE feature name, e.g. F0semitoneFrom27.5Hz_sma3nz_amean. Names containing clinical, risk or prediction-like terms (any letter case) are rejected. The list is a guard, not a proof of safety; reviewers must still check new feature sets.

value.description: Numeric value; null when status is not VALID.

unit.description: Unit where meaningful (e.g. semitone, dB, Hz, s, ratio); null for unitless or composite features.

status.description: MISSING: could not be computed (e.g. no voiced frames). INVALID: computed but non-finite or out of range. NOT_APPLICABLE: not defined for this input.

reason.description: Technical reason code when status is not VALID, e.g. INSUFFICIENT_VOICED_FRAMES, NON_FINITE_VALUE. Codes only, no free text.

x-changelog.changes: Supersedes contracts/voice-feature-schema.json v1.0.0. Breaking: features become an array of {name, value, unit, status, reason}; adds record_type, record_id, recording_id, processing_job_id; replaces consent_reference.permitted_purposes with scopes_verified (granular consent scopes, DRAFT); adds extraction, audio and processing blocks; quality status FAIL no longer produces a record; adds provenance.data_origin. See contracts/voice-features/README.md for the migration note.

x-governance.note: Produced only by the application-side audio-processing worker. Workstream B receives these records through the consent-filtered research export and never receives raw audio.
